about: Christmas Race Board (Henry, Nov 2026): Race Board's rules and code (games/race-board/app.js) with a Christmas question bank, Challenge squares and Forfeit cards. 100 questions for every level, with the answer in 'answer' (an index for A-D questions, text for spoken ones): 30 easy, 30 regular, 25 hard, 15 impossible, drawn in those proportions (shares). Math and science questions have a cat for the math-or-science chance card. christmas.squares = the Challenge squares; challenge and forfeit = the two card decks (20 each).
title: Christmas Race Board

challenge.title: Frozen Snowman
challenge.text: Everyone must freeze like a snowman for 5 seconds. No laughing or moving!

challenge.title: Reindeer Antlers
challenge.text: One player must make reindeer antlers with their hands and pose for 5 seconds.

challenge.title: Penguin Party
challenge.text: Everyone must waddle like penguins without moving away from their spots.

challenge.title: Robot Dance
challenge.text: One player must perform their best robot dance for 5 seconds.

challenge.title: Giant Present
challenge.text: Mime opening the biggest Christmas present imaginable. Make it dramatic!

challenge.title: Santa's Laugh
challenge.text: Everyone must perform their best Santa laugh together.

challenge.title: The Invisible Orchestra
challenge.text: One player must conduct an imaginary orchestra for 10 seconds.

challenge.title: Christmas Tree
challenge.text: Your entire team must create a Christmas tree pose together.

challenge.title: Slow-Motion Celebration
challenge.text: Celebrate winning a million dollars in extreme slow motion!

challenge.title: Hot Chocolate Disaster
challenge.text: Mime drinking extremely hot chocolate. Don't burn your tongue!

challenge.title: Animal Kingdom
challenge.text: Everyone chooses an animal and makes its noise at the same time.

challenge.title: Ice Skating
challenge.text: Mime performing an amazing ice-skating routine without moving from your spot.

challenge.title: Jazz Hands
challenge.text: Everyone must do their best jazz hands for 5 seconds.

challenge.title: The Wave
challenge.text: Create a mini wave with your team, one person after another.

challenge.title: Christmas Sound Effects
challenge.text: Make three Christmas-themed sound effects. The other team must guess what they are.

challenge.title: Stuck in the Chimney
challenge.text: One player must act like Santa trying to get out of a chimney.

challenge.title: Snowball Fight
challenge.text: Mime being in a snowball fight. No actual throwing or touching anyone!

challenge.title: Superhero Landing
challenge.text: Everyone must strike their most dramatic superhero pose.

challenge.title: Sleigh Pullers
challenge.text: Your team must pretend to pull Santa's heavy sleigh. Make it look difficult!

challenge.title: Elf Workshop
challenge.text: Everyone must pretend to be a busy elf making Christmas presents.

forfeit.title: Sleepy Santa
forfeit.text: Say "Ho, ho, ho!" like the sleepiest Santa in the world.

forfeit.title: The Royal Bow
forfeit.text: Give everyone a very dramatic royal bow.

forfeit.title: Robot Voice
forfeit.text: Say "Our team is still going to win!" in your best robot voice.

forfeit.title: Dropped Present
forfeit.text: Pretend you have dropped your Christmas presents. React dramatically!

forfeit.title: Frozen!
forfeit.text: Freeze in your funniest position for 5 seconds.

forfeit.title: Jazz Hands
forfeit.text: Do your best jazz hands while shouting your team's name.

forfeit.title: Animal Impression
forfeit.text: Make the sound of any animal. Your team must guess which animal it is.

forfeit.title: North Pole News
forfeit.text: Give a 10-second news report about something happening at the North Pole.

forfeit.title: Reindeer Sneeze
forfeit.text: Do your best reindeer sneeze. Make it dramatic!

forfeit.title: Tiny Mouse
forfeit.text: Say "Merry Christmas!" in the tiniest mouse voice possible.

forfeit.title: Air Guitar
forfeit.text: Play an imaginary guitar like a rock star for 5 seconds.

forfeit.title: Sports Commentator
forfeit.text: Announce your team's name like you're commentating on a World Cup final.

forfeit.title: Cookie Monster
forfeit.text: Mime eating the world's biggest Christmas cookie.

forfeit.title: Funny Face
forfeit.text: Make your funniest face and hold it for 5 seconds.

forfeit.title: Snow Angel
forfeit.text: Make an imaginary snow angel using only your arms. You can do this seated!

forfeit.title: Sleepy Reindeer
forfeit.text: Say "I need more sleep!" in your sleepiest voice.

forfeit.title: Shoulder Disco
forfeit.text: Do three shoulder rolls followed by your best disco pose.

forfeit.title: The Christmas Whisper
forfeit.text: Whisper "It's Christmas!" like you're sharing a very important secret.

forfeit.title: Monster Voice
forfeit.text: Say "Where are my presents?" in your best monster voice.

forfeit.title: Christmas Morning
forfeit.text: Your whole team must create a frozen statue showing Christmas morning.

intro.title: Christmas Race!
text: Every team has a piece on START.
First team to land exactly on FINISH wins!

intro.title: Your turn
text: Answer one question. Harder questions = more dice!
Wrong? Roll the same dice backwards, or take a Forfeit.

intro.title: Power-ups
text: Each team can use each power-up ONCE per game.
50/50, +20 seconds, Free answer, or Risk it!

rows: right 2 big dice, wrong 2 big back

intro.title: Special squares
text: ★ forward · ⚠ back · 🎲 roll again · ? chance · 🎄 challenge.

intro.title: Challenges and forfeits
text: 🎄 square: draw a Challenge card and do it together!
Wrong answer? Do a Forfeit and stay put, or roll back.

intro.title: Exact finish
text: You need the exact number to land on FINISH.
Too many? Bounce back the extra squares.
